mcqs.q: What is the difference between a natural hazard and a natural disaster?
options: Fold mountains form from giant volcanoes erupting upwards.
A hazard happens on land and a disaster happens at sea.
A natural hazard is a physical event with potential to cause harm; it becomes a disaster only when it affects vulnerable people and causes significant impact.
They are the same thing — any earthquake or hurricane is a disaster.

mcqs.q: What is the main criticism of Rostow's stages of economic growth?
options: Rostow's model is universally accepted as the best development theory.
All LICs will pass through Rostow's five stages if they wait long enough.
A hazard happens on land and a disaster happens at sea.

It assumes all countries can follow the same linear Western industrialisation path, ignoring colonial legacies, global trade inequalities and environmental constraints — a top-down modernisation view.

mcqs.q: How are fold mountains like the Himalayas formed?
options: Fold mountains form when one plate slides under another into the mantle.
A hazard happens on land and a disaster happens at sea.
By the collision of two continental plates (India and Eurasia) where neither can subduct, so the crust crumples and is forced upwards over millions of years.
Fold mountains form from giant volcanoes erupting upwards.
